retrieval_cases.question: What is the maximum service credit for one incident?

hits.title: Service-credit policy
hits.text:
Service-credit policy
A confirmed service failure, such as a disrupted ride caused by an outage, may qualify for a discretionary goodwill service credit after human review. Only the Support Lead may approve a service credit, with a maximum total value of INR 200 for one incident and no automatic entitlement. An issued service credit expires after 30 calendar days, is non-transferable, and cannot be exchanged for cash.

hits.title: Outage communication
hits.text:
Outage communication
Provide progress updates every 30 elapsed minutes until restoration is confirmed, including outside routine support hours. State only verified service impact, a confirmed start time when known, and the next update time; never invent a restoration estimate or expose personal customer details.

hits.text:
Business hours and holiday support
Routine support operates Monday through Saturday from 09:00 to 18:00 Indian Standard Time, using the Asia/Kolkata time zone.
